title: heracleum pyrenaicum subsp. orsinii
intro: Heracleum pyrenaicum subsp. orsinii, commonly known as Orsin's hog's fennel, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). Orsin's hog's fennel is valued for its potential health benefits, particularly in reducing inflammation and alleviating pain, due to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including furanocoumarins, such as bergapten and psoralen, which have been shown to exhibit phototoxic and anti-inflammatory activities. However, the exact bioactive constituents and their effects on human health require further research and validation.
